SUPPLY_MASTERY_EXPLAIN: Every 5 uses of a supply raise its mastery by one level, up to ^%d. Buying or finding supplies adds stock only. Prestige keeps mastery levels and use progress.
SUPPLY_NO_MERGE: Every five uses raise Supply Mastery. Prestige keeps mastery and use progress.
MERGE_ALL_LOCKED_HINT: Merge All: unlock it once for 500 gems in Upgrades → Inventory.
RESET_LINE_RUN_PROGRESS: Unfinished Prestige opportunities. Pending offline Coins and Gems are paid first; unclaimed offline item copies are lost.
PRESTIGE_RESET_RUN: Every item you carry (supplies included) and its random bonus attributes, map access (back to Winter I), owned camps and unfinished Prestige opportunities.
